## Question

How does response classification change after reconstructing plot-cover family AUCs?

## Dataset and sample size

Family effects are reconstructed from the retained resident community for the same 42 experiments; exact effects and families appear in the diagnostics.

## Exact model specification

The fixed and random structures mirror `M_both`, replacing species with family after raw-cover aggregation and full family-AUC covariance reconstruction.

## Assumptions

Family identities follow validated taxonomy plus the single explicit `Viola palustris` → `Violaceae` decision.

## Convergence and covariance diagnostics

Optimizer, positive-definiteness, identifiability, covariance, support, and classification gates are shown below.

## Main numerical results

```{r}
model <- targets::tar_read(family_model_summary)
summary <- targets::tar_read(family_classification_summary)
classification <- targets::tar_read(family_classification_526)
validation <- targets::tar_read(family_bundle_validation)
comparison <- targets::tar_read(species_family_resolution_comparison)
data_gate <- targets::tar_read(family_auc_data_equivalence)
V_gate <- targets::tar_read(family_V_equivalence)
fit_gate <- targets::tar_read(family_model_equivalence)
class_gate <- targets::tar_read(family_classification_equivalence)
summary_gate <- targets::tar_read(family_model_summary_equivalence)
override <- targets::tar_read(canonical_family_override_table)
knitr::kable(model)
knitr::kable(summary)
knitr::kable(validation)
knitr::kable(comparison)
knitr::kable(dplyr::bind_rows(data_gate, V_gate, fit_gate, class_gate, summary_gate))
knitr::kable(override)
knitr::kable(head(classification, 20))
```

## Interpretation boundary

Species effects are not averaged; family AUC and its full covariance are
reconstructed from plot cover. The `Viola palustris` family value is the
explicit `Violaceae` decision validated in the Step 19, Step 20, and anchored
Step 22 lineages and stored in the shared downstream override ledger.

## Canonical objects

`family_auc_bundle_526`, `family_model_bundle_526`, `family_support_526`, and `family_classification_526`.

## PASS/FAIL

Cover reconstruction, data, covariance, fitted model, support, random coefficients, classification, and summary must all reproduce the frozen reference.
